key_findings: RNase4 is selectively expressed in unmyelinated nociceptor subtypes (Sst+ and partly Calca+) and is upregulated in nociceptors after nerve crush injury.
Adult nociceptor-specific RNase4 deletion transiently increases mechanical sensitivity, whereas embryonic deletion leaves baseline pain thresholds unchanged.
